name: Citta Alta
tagline: Historic hilltop town inside Venetian walls
description: The UNESCO-listed upper town crowns the hill, ringed by 16th-century Venetian walls. Cobbled lanes lead to Piazza Vecchia, the Palazzo della Ragione and the Colleoni Chapel, with the funicular linking it to the lower town below.
bestFor: Nomads who want atmosphere, views and living inside living history

name: Centro / Sentierone
tagline: Modern lower-town heart and main promenade
description: The lively core of Citta Bassa centres on the Sentierone promenade, with elegant arcades, shops, cafes and the Donizetti theatre. It offers the best everyday amenities, modern flats and quick transport links across the city and to the airport.
bestFor: Nomads wanting cafes, coworking, shops and easy connections nearby

name: Borgo Santa Caterina
tagline: Charming local district with village feel
description: A characterful borgo just east of the centre, Santa Caterina keeps a genuine neighbourhood atmosphere with its own church, weekly market, independent shops and trattorias. It sits close to the walls yet feels residential, relaxed and pleasantly local.
bestFor: Nomads seeking local life, calm streets and good value near the centre

name: Longuelo / San Leonardo
tagline: Leafy residential area west of centre
description: West of the core, Longuelo and the Borgo San Leonardo district offer quieter, greener residential streets, family homes and everyday services. Well connected by bus, they give more space and lower rents while keeping the centre and hills within easy reach.
bestFor: Nomads wanting space, calm and affordability with easy centre access
